title: Volleyball
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 8 Creative Arts and Sports; not yet checked by a CBC Creative Arts and Sports teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Overarm serves from closer to the net first; volleys in pairs.

skills.key_step: The child describes the overarm serve (toss, hit with an open hand above the head), the volley (fingertips above the forehead), six players and three touches.

floor.prerequisite: Knows the under-arm serve and dig (Grade 6).
floor.question: Which part of the body plays a dig?

steps: Volley: hands make a window, push with fingers.

misconceptions.ask: How many players are on the court for a volleyball team?
misconceptions.repair: Draw the court: three at the front, three at the back.

misconceptions.ask: How is the overarm serve hit?
misconceptions.repair: Toss the ball and hit it with an open hand above the head.

misconceptions.ask: How many touches does a team have before sending the ball over?
misconceptions.repair: Play dig, volley, spike: three touches.

misconceptions.ask: Which part of the hand touches the ball in a volley?
misconceptions.repair: Make a window with the hands above the forehead and catch the ball on the fingers.

checks.question: How many players are on court for one team?
How many touches before the ball goes over?
